notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
[b]Added[/b]

[*] Rollover effect to custom skin selection
[*] Hover effects to all buttons
[*] Add sound effects to button hover
[/list]

[b]Updated[/b]

[*] Logo on Main Menu

[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Star time requirement info dialog box viewable by hovering mouse over info icon
[*] Fixed music volume glitch that would cause volume to increase to max when opening speedrun select screen
[*] Fixed level rollover texture glitch in level select
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] The Level Select button with Level Select screen is now animated along with sound effect when mouse hovers over
[*] The mini buttons in the main menu are now animated as well as a sound is played when mouse hovers over
[*] Cursor window lock has been enabled to prevent mouse cursor leaving game window during play
[/list]
